scenes.headline: Gold Layer
scenes.subtitle: Business-ready aggregates and metrics
scenes.narration: The gold layer delivers curated, aggregated data optimized for reporting, dashboards, and decision-making.

scenes.headline: What gold contains
items: Tables tuned for BI query performance
scenes.narration: Gold holds the metrics leaders actually consume, like daily active users or revenue. It often follows dimensional models such as star schemas. These tables are shaped and tuned for fast dashboard queries.

scenes.headline: Silver to gold
scenes.narration: Gold pipelines read clean silver tables and roll them up. Business rules and metric definitions are applied consistently. The output is a set of purpose-built marts for consumption.

scenes.headline: Creating a gold aggregate
scenes.code:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE gold.daily_page_views AS
SELECT
  page_id,
  DATE(event_ts) AS event_date,
  COUNT(*) AS views,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_visitors
FROM silver.clickstream_enriched
GROUP BY page_id, DATE(event_ts);
scenes.narration: This query aggregates enriched silver events into daily page metrics. It counts total views and distinct visitors per page and day. The resulting gold table powers reporting without rescanning raw data.

scenes.headline: Silver vs gold
scenes.narration: Silver is granular and general-purpose across the organization. Gold is narrowed and aggregated for specific reporting needs. Consumers hit gold for speed and clarity, while data teams maintain silver as the foundation.

scenes.text: Gold is where data becomes decisions: curated, aggregated, and fast.
scenes.narration: A well-built gold layer means executives get trustworthy numbers in seconds, not hours.
